text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I want you to watch how I run today!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: McQueen! Hurry, hurry! Dash for it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Teio-san. Seats have already been 
prepared for us, though..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text: ...Hang in there, Tsuru-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
To the people who have always cheered for 
me. To the people who have always 
supported me.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
...You worked so hard, Tsu-chan. Making it 
all the way to a massive stage like this.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Dear. Let's watch until the very end 
today. Fufu... It's still too early to 
wipe away tears, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(—To the people I want to tell that I'm 
standing here.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen. Before the 
race, a certain Umamusume was scheduled to 
visit the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: President!!
choice_data_list: Welcome, I'll make some tea right now

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"No, don't mind me. It's a crucial moment 
right before your race, so I don't intend 
to linger for long."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...You're remarkably calm. Even before a 
grand stage like the Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. I'm totally used to running in GⅠs 
now!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, is that so? Whoa—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hanging there on that wall... are your 
thousand paper cranes, right?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Every single one of those cranes 
represents... the feelings of everyone who 
supports me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see. ......Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To think I could become an inspiration to 
such a wonderful Umamusume... It's truly 
an honor.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...! ......President.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"That is the charm of the 'Emperor' 
Symboli Rudolf, who commands the 
'absolute'!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It's almost time, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside Symboli Rudolf and her personal 
physician, I see Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi off to 
the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder how many times we've had this 
exchange by now. Yet, every time I see her 
off, I can't help but think."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The next time I welcome her back, she 
will return even stronger than when I sent 
her off."
choice_data_list:
Go out there and become the strongest! 
Tsuyoshi!

Go out there and become the strongest! 
Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Yes!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! The curtain has risen! Now is 
the moment the spotlight shines upon me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm also this year's Kikuka Sho Umamusume! 
I'm gonna give it all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, what a hot-blooded 
generation~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~. Are you two really the ones to be 
saying that~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of yielding the track 
to underclassmen or upperclassmen alike.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...And the monster devours even the birds 
soaring through the sky.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno! I love this bloodlust-desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now this is what a race should be! A race 
against a true rival!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —Now, the last person is here with us.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Great to be with you all today!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Betting on the pride of the "absolute" I 
have built up, I will blaze a path.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Right here, today— the "possibility" of 
defeating you all!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Great ring-in, Tsuru-chan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Still, don't you dare underestimate me! 
You're looking at none other than the 
world-renowned El Condor Pasa!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to show you the world-tempered 
toughness of El-chan right awayyy!!
